design_copy.everything_starts_at_youtube_studio_your: Everything starts at YouTube Studio -- your mission control for going live. Open it up and find the "Go Live"button.
design_copy.think_of_your_stream_key_like_a_secret_v: Think of your Stream Key like a secret VIP backstage pass. It tells YouTube: "Hey, this video is really from ME!"In YouTube Studio, find the "Stream"tab and click Copy next to Default Stream Key.
design_copy.open_obs_studio_on_your_computer_go_to_s: Open OBS Studio on your computer, go to Settings > Stream, and paste your Stream Key and Server URL there. This wires your camera straight to YouTube.
design_copy.press_start_streaming_in_obs_first_then_: Press "Start Streaming"in OBS first, then tap Go Live below to launch your broadcast to the world. 3... 2... 1... liftoff!
design_copy.first_time_going_live_on_youtube_your_ch: First time going live on YouTube? Your channel needs a one-time, 24-hour verification before live streaming unlocks. If you've streamed before, skip ahead -- you're already good to go!
design_copy.grab_your_stream_key_from_youtube_studio: Grab your Stream Key from YouTube Studio's "Stream"tab and paste it once below. We'll remember it for next time, so you only ever have to do this once.
design_copy.tap_open_camera_and_your_phone_s_own_cam: Tap Open Camera and your phone's own camera and microphone become the broadcast. No laptop, no OBS -- just you, live.
design_copy.this_mode_streams_straight_over_your_loc: This mode streams straight over your local Wi-Fi -- no internet needed. Just make sure your phone and your laptop are connected to the same network.
design_copy.find_your_laptop_s_local_ip_address_usua: Find your laptop's local IP address (usually starts with 192.168...), type it in below, and tap Stream. You're broadcasting locally in seconds.
design_copy.clipboard_is_empty_or_too_short_to_be_a_: Clipboard is empty or too short to be a stream key.
design_copy.you_can_only_own_one_personal_broadcaste: You can only own one personal broadcaster channel. Please select which channel you want to keep. The unselected channel will be deleted permanently.
design_copy.quality_help: Higher quality looks better but needs a stronger upload. You can't change this once you start the camera.
